page_title: A new way to read & write Markdown

sources.entry: Typora - Truly minimal Markdown editor featuring seamless live preview.

summary.name: Typora
summary.one_liner: Typora is a minimal, cross-platform Markdown editor and reader that shows a live preview in place of raw syntax symbols.
keywords: what you see is what you mean
use_cases: writing and reading Markdown documents without raw syntax
taking notes with math formulas and diagrams
organizing a folder of Markdown articles
exporting Markdown to PDF, docx, LaTeX or Epub
writing long documents with an outline view
customizing the editor's look with CSS themes
summary.what_it_does: Typora is a Markdown editor that hides syntax symbols and renders content as a live preview while you type, with no separate preview window or mode switch. It supports images, headers, ordered, unordered and task lists, tables, code fences, math, diagrams, and inline styles. It includes a file tree and file list side panel, an outline panel for jumping between sections, and a word count that reports words, characters, lines, or reading minutes. Focus mode blurs all lines except the current one, and typewriter mode keeps the active line centered. Export covers PDF with bookmarks, and import/export also covers docx, OpenOffice, LaTeX, MediaWiki and Epub.
notable: Live preview that hides Markdown syntax (WYSIWYM)
Exports to PDF with bookmarks and many other formats
caveats: Purchase required at $14.99 (without tax) after a 15-day free trial, up to 3 devices
Platforms listed are macOS, Linux and Windows (64-bit, 32-bit and ARM builds)
